scenes.purpose: Put the question to the oil-heated viewer before the advice lands.

visual.description: Dark field; the question "Heat with oil?" types on in large type and holds while the advice is spoken.

scenes.direction: Cold open; the question types on with the first words, then holds.
scenes.narration: Heat with oil and own a heat pump? One evaluation's advice: switch the heat pump off on the coldest days and let the oil burner run.

scenes.purpose: Show the two switch-off temperatures side by side, each on its year, while the narration names what set them.

visual.description: Two stat tiles stacked in the portrait frame, 2015 above 2016; each tile's figure lands as it is spoken, 8°F first then 25°F; the note says these are switch-off temperatures, not savings.

chart.title: Switch the heat pump off below
chart.note: Outdoor temperatures below which oil ran cheaper in that year; not a saving figure.

scenes.direction: First tile on "8", second on "25"; both hold through "dearer oil moves it lower"; a beat after the sentence.
scenes.narration: The switch-off point was 8 degrees Fahrenheit in 2015 and 25 the year after, set by that year's oil and electricity prices and the heat pump's cold performance; dearer oil moves it lower.

scenes.purpose: Scope the advice: one evaluation, oil only; propane and resistance went to the heat pump.

visual.description: Three lines build down the frame as each fuel is named: oil watches the line, propane and electric resistance go to the heat pump.

scenes.direction: Lines on "oil-heated", "propane" and "resistance"; "watch the line" is not spoken, so the first line lands with "oil-heated homes only"; hold after the sentence.
scenes.narration: That is one evaluation of ductless mini-splits, and the advice is for oil-heated homes only: against propane and electric resistance it found the heat pump cheaper.

scenes.purpose: End card: the action for the oil-heated viewer and the pointer to the full inquiry.

visual.description: Two short lines, drawn as the end card: the action first, then the pointer to the full inquiry.

scenes.direction: First line on "this year's prices", second on "full inquiry"; hold to the end.
scenes.narration: If you heat with oil, ask which heater runs cheaper at this year's prices; the full inquiry asks where a heat pump pays at all.
